aggregation.percentage_cross_entropy_recall_and_base: unweighted arithmetic mean across fixed masks

paired_seed_deltas.direction_convention: positive accuracy deltas and positive baseline-minus-wider cross-entropy favor the wider model

relaxed_jacobian_gate.metric: per-seed mean whole-node exact masked-token accuracy percent
relaxed_jacobian_gate.reason: At least one wider-model seed is not strictly above 95% exact accuracy, so the relaxed categorical Jacobian is skipped.

reproducibility_notice.exact_reproduction_instruction: Use the checked source experiment definitions and verify the resulting config against each bundle's config.resolved.yaml.

scope.estimand: held-in whole-node exact masked raw-count-token reconstruction
